Dopamine is not a pleasure signal. Watch.
Give an animal a surprise drop of juice, and its dopamine neurons burst.
Now flash a lamp before every juice. The burst moves to the lamp.
And if the lamp comes but the juice does not: silence, exactly when the juice was due.
Dopamine does not say good. It says better than I expected. The same error signal that A.I. uses to learn.
